heading: Google Pixel 11 gets cheaper: Here's the latest deal
paragraphs: If the Google Pixel 11 was on your wishlist, Amazon might make you take another look.
The smartphone is currently listed at Rs 81,999, while the device's launch price is Rs 89,999.
That means you're getting a direct discount of Rs 8,000. The discount doesn't end here; there's more.
Buyers can also get bank offers of up to Rs 3,000, bringing the effective price down even further.
With this additional bank offer, the effective price of the Google Pixel 11 drops to Rs 78,999.

The Pixel 11 gets a 6.3-inch OLED display with a smooth 120Hz refresh rate. It also supports HDR10+ and can reach up to 3,000 nits of peak brightness, so the screen should stay easy to see even outdoors.
The Pixel 11 gets a triple rear camera setup, led by a 48-megapixel main camera. It is joined by a 10.8-megapixel telephoto camera with 5x optical zoom and a 13-megapixel ultrawide camera.
Powering the phone is Google’s Tensor G6 chipset, built on a 3nm process. It comes with 12GB RAM and runs Android 17, with Google promising up to seven major OS updates.
The phone packs a 4,985mAh battery with 30W wired charging. It also supports 25W magnetic wireless charging through Qi2.2, along with reverse wired charging and bypass charging.
